difficulty_reason: Two-condition criterion (etale-site equivalence + affine Mor lifting); reduce to affine B by an etale covering and the fpqc-locality of pushouts (lemma-pushout-fpqc-local), then prove Mor_B(X,Z) -> lim Mor_B(X_i,Z) bijective: injectivity via the (1)-isomorphism U ≅ U' glued from affine charts and the etale descent of the equality f∘p = g∘p; surjectivity by constructing an etale covering {U_c -> X} on which the compatible family f_{c,i} descends - pull back affine charts Z_a of Z, realize U_a through (1), refine to affine U_{a,b}, apply (2) to get f_{a,b}, and descend across the covering by the injectivity already proven.
